hero.undertitel: Bible, faith & gladly a bit controversial

senaste.undertitel: Fresh videos and podcast episodes – straight from BibelBecca's YouTube channel

om.text: I love the Bible and want to help more people discover it. On my channel I answer Bible questions, clear up common misconceptions and talk about faith on the BibelBecca podcast.

cta.rubrik: Want to help make the podcast possible?
cta.text: BibelBecca is run on a non-profit basis. By sponsoring equipment – like microphones, cameras and lighting – you help the content reach further.
